author: TomasVial
attribution: Photo: TomasVial, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Calle_Arquitecta_Montserrat_Palmer_Trias.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Yellow arrow-shaped street-name blade with pedestrian, dining, book and number pictograms, Providencia, Santiago (camera -33.4223, -70.6119). The sign writes TRIAS without an accent (the official name is Trías). Leaf shadows across the blade. Distractor: a second, angled yellow blade below 'BARRIO PASEO PROVIDENCIA / LAS URBINAS'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_categories: Street signs in Santiago de Chile

author: Jorge Barrios R.
attribution: Photo: Jorge Barrios R., CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Placa_conmemorativa_del_cerro_Primo_de_Rivera.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Rough granite block with black-painted carved letters at Cerro Primo de Rivera, Maipú (camera -33.4949, -70.7570), seen at an angle from below. HISTORICO is carved without an accent. Two faint lines carved below the name are illegible and not transcribed. Distractor: brown national-monument board behind, 'MONUMENTO NACIONAL / CERRO PRIMO DE ...' (cut by the block). location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Placa conmemorativa del cerro Primo de Rivera.jpg

author: Pdassori
attribution: Photo: Pdassori, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:LetreroValdivia_costanera.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large outline letters made of rusty steel standing on the lawn of the riverside Costanera, Valdivia (camera -39.8123, -73.2476). Letters are open frames (the I's look like narrow rectangles, the A's have triangle inserts), so word shapes are unusual. People in the background are incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_categories: 3D letter place name signs in Chile

author: Bernard Gagnon

notes: Brushed-steel street blade with red letters and the house-number range 200 (left) to 298 (right), on a pole in central Santiago (camera -33.4408, -70.6508). Distractors: the 'Claro video / Descarga la APP' advert panel above, a pedestrian-pictogram blade at right, and a Starbucks logo behind. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Jorge Barrios R.

author: Jorge Barrios R.
attribution: Photo: Jorge Barrios R., CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Plaza_Pescador_Francisco_Ceballos_Seco_-_El_Quisco.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Wavy-edged wooden board with burnt/painted black letters on two posts, on the Costanera of El Quisco (camera -33.3951, -71.6979). 'Fco.' abbreviates Francisco; there is almost no space after 'Fco.' and only a narrow gap between Ceballos and Seco. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Jorge Barrios R.
attribution: Photo: Jorge Barrios R., CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Playa_Hanga_Roa_2023_-_03.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Municipal beach board in El Quisco (camera -33.3981, -71.7005), angled view; the beach name is the large heading. Only the heading and the two warning lines under it are transcribed. The rest of the board is a list of rules (PROHIBIDO EL TRÁNSITO DE VEHÍCULOS EN LA PLAYA, ...), emergency numbers (TELÉFONOS DE EMERGENCIA, 131 ATENCIÓN MÉDICA URGENCIA, ...), a Municipalidad de El Quisco crest and a red bottom band 'NO APTA PARA EL BAÑO'. Two vertical shadow stripes from the posts cross the board. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Jorge Barrios Riquelme
attribution: Photo: Jorge Barrios Riquelme, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Acceso_Cerro_Primo_de_Rivera_-_Maip%C3%BA_-_2019.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Tall corten-steel pillar at the park entrance, Maipú (camera -33.4953, -70.7572), with dark letters written vertically (rotated 90°, reading bottom to top); low contrast, small in the frame. Different physical sign from c137845645 (same site). Distractors: 'PARQUE INTERCOMUNAL' in large letters on the wall, a street blade 'ANUNCIACIÓN' with a two-way arrow, and a small cut street blade. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Acceso Cerro Primo de Rivera - Maipú - 2019.jpg
